latHint: Think the black dot in your eye - not a flower.
pivHint: An IRIS is a tall flower - but the IRIS is also the colored ring around what part of the eye?
winText: Eyes wide. IRIS was the pivot - a flower to the eye's PUPIL.
lossText: PUPIL - the dark opening in the eye. IRIS was the pivot: a garden IRIS to the IRIS of the eye.
